_help: Manual control panel. placements: set team ids (from data/teams.js) once the tournament ends, e.g. {"first": "spain", "second": "argentina", "third": "france", "fourth": "england"}. goldenBootWinner: the actual golden boot player's name — used as the tiebreaker (matched loosely against each player's pick). advancedTeams: team ids to force-award the past-group-stage bonus if the API is slow to publish round-of-32 fixtures. excludeMatchIds: API match ids to ignore. manualMatches: hand-entered matches in the same shape as results.json matches (use negative ids to avoid collisions).
